customManagers.description: The workflows run images by tag and digest (hadolint, the BuildKit of the image builds); the tag and the digest move together
The ShellCheck workflow downloads the ShellCheck release the pre-commit hook runs: the same package as that hook, so both move in the same pull request
The kvsctl workflow runs govulncheck at a pinned version
The pre-commit workflow installs pre-commit at a pinned version
The detect-secrets hook rewrites a baseline that names another version than its own, which fails the hook: the baseline moves with the hook, in the same pull request

packageRules.description: Dependency updates keep the chore(deps) prefix the history and the release notes already use
Every minor, patch and digest update, whatever its manager, goes into one pull request a week, merged once CI passes
Every major update goes into a second pull request a week, merged once CI passes like the first: apart, so a major that breaks the build never holds the other updates back

An action pinned to a commit whose commit changes while its version stays is an action whose tag was moved, which a release does not do: the update waits for approval on the dependency dashboard, in a pull request of its own that is never merged by itself
The same for the images the workflows run by tag and digest, named one by one

Bubble Tea, Bubbles and Lip Gloss 2 moved to charm.land with a new API, a change of code no bot makes, and the printing of Bubble Tea 2.1.0 above an inline program writes over the terminal history the kvsctl screen prints its notes under: they stay on 1.x
The go line of cli/go.mod is the toolchain CI and the release build kvsctl with, bumped like any version
Its patch releases carry the standard library fixes govulncheck asks for: they come as soon as they are old enough, in a pull request of their own
